name: iPhone X
why_not_wda: WebDriverAgent / Appium would read this as a view tree. TikTok obfuscates that tree and the runner injects. These are per-screen coordinate maps, calibrated by eye, tapped via SpringBoard HID.

feed.note: For You / Following. The + sits in the tab bar, above the home indicator.

camera.note: In-app camera after +. Upload is the control that opens the library; the shutter is the one we must not hit.

picker.note: Recents grid. first_asset is the most-recent import; PhotoKit / UIKit save puts the new file first. next is this screen's Next, not the editor's.

editor.note: Trim / effects. next here is a different tap from picker.next even when the numbers look the same.

composer.note: Caption + Post. This is the tap that spends the upload. Do not mark calibrated until you have watched it land on Post, not Next.

flow.why: open the in-app camera, not a view-tree 'create' node
send. the observer is what confirms it left
